text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The long-awaited "Tenno Sho (Autumn)" is 
finally here. I acknowledge the gap in 
strength between myself, Opera O-san, and 
Doto-san. Even so, there must be a way 
forward...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Just then, a sudden downpour! But having 
run on all kinds of tracks, I can handle 
bad ground no problem. In fact, it's my 
home turf! I'm SO OP, LOL!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I shall display the true pride of an 
all-rounder! A hero does not choose the 
battlefield—! *(strikes a determined 
pose)*
